findings.motion: Third Reading, Roll Call #882, HB 589 (VIVA/Election Reform)
findings.note: Senate third-reading vote on House Bill 589, which passed 33-14. The roll call lists Newton among the Ayes. The filed text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2013/Bills/House/PDF/H589v0.pdf) is titled VIVA and, as filed, requires voters to provide photo identification before voting; the final Senate version was not read line by line, so the ID rules in the version voted on are not confirmed here.

findings.motion: Co-sponsor of SB 88, Various Elections Changes (filed as Election Day Integrity Act)
findings.note: The bill page lists B. Newton among the co-sponsors (primary sponsors: Daniel, P. Newton, Hise). As filed, it changed the deadline for mail-in absentee ballots to be received. The engrossed third edition (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2023/Bills/Senate/PDF/S88v3.pdf) adds challenges to ballots of voters ineligible by death or felony conviction and signature verification on absentee ballots. Last action: referred to House Rules on 2024-06-26. Date shown is the filing date; the date Newton was added as co-sponsor is not shown on the page.

findings.motion: Co-sponsor of SB 352, Remove Foreign Citizens from Voting Rolls
findings.note: The bill page lists B. Newton among the co-sponsors (primary sponsor: Burgin). The filed text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2023/Bills/Senate/PDF/S352v0.pdf) requires United States citizenship to serve as a juror and shares the names of people excused from jury duty for lack of citizenship with the State Board of Elections. Last action: referred to Senate Rules on 2023-03-23. Date shown is the filing date; the date Newton was added is not shown.
subjects: proof of citizenship (related: jury-duty citizenship data shared with elections board)
